description: Atlas evidence: submit an asset id or ticker. The signed report gives the latest NAV figure on record for the asset with its unit, reading time, publisher and URL as the dataset carries them, the catalog NAV beside it, and its age at the dataset’s own market timestamp from the dataset version. POST /api/atlas-nav-evidence. Reads the published Tokenization Atlas dataset at https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets once per call, with no dataset writes and no issuer contact. Every report names the dataset version it read, and a field or history the dataset does not hold is reported as not in the published dataset. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/atlas-evidence-contract. Human page: https://atlas.weverlabs.com/.

asset.description: An Atlas asset id or ticker as it appears in the dataset, matched case-insensitively. Example: paxg or PAXG.
